_comment: Source script for the complete React workflow shared with source Playwright acceptance. No recording or narration generated. Owner must verify the live frontend/backend pair, narration and measured per-beat timing before READY_OWNER_VERIFIED. Existing kit provenance and NOT_CONFIGURED gate remain.

segments.captionText: LastTake uses durable Strands interrupts so a script supervisor can pause a wrap workflow on its evidence and a first assistant director can resume it later. This capture begins after the fictional shoot day has opened. The screen shows supplied records before any checkpoint result. The scene is synthetic; no crew trial, time saving or avoided cost is claimed.

segments.captionText: Open a take in the lined script and compare the sidecar with its independent camera report. The linked records show what was supplied. A take without a report stays missing evidence. LastTake does not analyze footage or audio, choose a performance, or determine legal sufficiency.

segments.captionText: Select Run wrap checkpoint. The browser request records scene.wrap-checkpoint.requested on EventBridge, then directly starts the Strands orchestrator; no EventBridge rule or subscriber triggers it. Four bounded checks and a deterministic gate report 34 required beats: 31 covered with evidence, 2 exceptions with named sources, and 1 missing release routed to production. The hosted demo uses a scripted planner and offline lexical interpreter. A separate backend deployment check exercises Amazon Bedrock through the same interpreter port; Bedrock is not active in this browser.

segments.captionText: First record the supervisor's continuity decision against the current sources. Then select the first assistant director and reload. The saved Strands interrupt returns. Explicit approval resumes the tool, while wrap remains unapproved. Strands supplies this saved tool loop and replay. S3 stores its session and Aurora DSQL stores the AWS run state.

segments.captionText: Now change the evidence. Download the editable fictional take as JSON and load that file into the review form. Nothing is submitted until Save. The new take includes its separate camera report, and saving reruns the affected checks. The earlier continuity decision no longer applies. Supply the release record, review the new continuity evidence as supervisor, and record the DIT's decision on the metadata exception. Each decision names its reviewer and reason.

segments.captionText: Review wrap readiness as the first assistant director and request wrap approval. Eligibility is separate from human authority. Reload restores the pending request for the changed package. Inspect its fingerprint, then explicitly approve. The saved confirmation appears only when the server reports the human decision. Demo roles do not authenticate real production staff.

segments.captionText: In Handoff, publish the approved turnover and reload it. Download the saved manifest and prepare the wrap receipt. They bind the reviewed package and keep accepted exceptions visible. Editorial receives a usable beat-to-take map, technical records and source digests in the download or copyable summary. Storage and bus acceptance do not prove downstream delivery. Hashes identify bytes, not truth; earlier evidence and component disclosures remain available.
